products.name: Respeecher
products.note: Voice cloning for media; entertainment focus; likeness rights; Ukrainian vendor

profile_text.body:
Respeecher is a Ukraine-based team of sound professionals that builds AI voice generation technology for studios, media teams, and individual creators. The company describes itself as offering a professional AI voice generator tuned for real production workflows, with an emphasis on timing, tone, and emotional intent rather than generic output. Its tools are positioned for use in film, games, broadcast, and enterprise media contexts.

The company's core products include a voice cloning service capable of replicating the vocal characteristics of specific individuals, a text-to-speech API supporting multiple languages and regional accents including English variants, and a Marketplace where users can test voices before committing to a purchase. Respeecher states that its voice synthesis blends public models with proprietary technology built by sound engineers, and that its system is language-agnostic when working from recorded source material. The company also describes a framework for consent and rights management as part of its approach to ethical deployment, which aligns with the held facts noting an entertainment focus and attention to likeness rights.

The site includes a testimonial referencing the reconstruction of a deceased person's voice, illustrating the sensitivity of some use cases the company handles. Respeecher is tracked on theworldofai.org under the Voice and Audio category, with no litigation, SEC filings, or patent records currently held.
